build_MMFDataset: build an MMFDataset instance with a config that loads annotations, images, and features databases
create_annotation_db: create an annotation database from a config path using the build_annotation_db method
build_features_db: build a features database linked to the annotation database via the build_features_db method
build_image_db: build an image database linked to the annotation database via the build_image_db method
review_MMFDataset_init: review the MMFDataset constructor to understand how use_images and use_features flags control database loading
